Title: CANCELLED - French National Qualifier - 1st April 2013 - Lille

Messages.Author: Vlad
Messages.Body:
Hello everyone,
Lille is organizing a National Qualifier after the Northern ECQ for France.

The event will be held in the Croisades d'Unnord convention.

We will start at 10 am for a two rounds + final tournament.

The address of the event is :
13 Rue de Toul
59800 Lille
France

It's a 10-15 min walk from metro stations "Port de Lille", "Cormontagne", "République Beaux-Arts", and a 25 min walk from the international Gare de Lille-Flandres train station, and an extra 5 mins from the Lille-Europe train station.

Entrance fee will be 6 Euros. This covers promos, boosters and / or goodies...

The format is the same construct as usual. Banned cards are banned, no card-limit (apart from the 60-90/12 usual requirements)

We'll be very pleased to have players from Belgium, the UK, Netherlands or Germany attend the event

If we are less than 11 we can play it with the MultiDeck option...

Pentex Board of Directors

Prince of Oye Plage
Alastor Grand Nord
